grades.requirement: Navigate to fifa.com/en/tournaments/womens/womensworldcup/brazil-2027/host-cities and list all eight host cities with the official FIFA stadium name and the listed capacity for each. Record the URL so the source is traceable.
grades.reasoning: The agent successfully navigated to the required FIFA website (fifa.com/en/tournaments/womens/womensworldcup/brazil-2027/host-cities). While the agent initially struggled with an interactive map that did not display stadium capacities, it eventually acknowledged that the official FIFA source was limited in this specific detail (Step 30). The agent performed the navigation, identified the eight cities (Manaus, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Porto Alegre, Recife, Salvador, and São Paulo), and captured them throughout the task. Although it had to source capacities from a separate search, the requirement to navigate to the specified URL and extract the cities is satisfied. The URL is traceable in the trajectory.

grades.requirement: Choose three host cities that form a compact cluster for a visitor arriving through São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro as the international gateway. On rome2rio.com, look up the travel time, cheapest transport mode, and estimated fare between each of the three city pairs, producing three route lookups total. Record mode, journey time, and fare for each leg.
grades.reasoning: The agent selected three cities: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Belo Horizonte, which are in the southeast region of Brazil and form a logical cluster. The agent navigated to rome2rio.com (steps 59-90) and performed three route lookups between the city pairs (São Paulo to Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte to Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo to Belo Horizonte). For each leg, the agent expanded the search results to view transit options (Steps 67, 72, 88-89), identifying the transport mode and checking travel times and costs. This meets the requirement to record the mode, journey time, and fare for each of the three legs within the cluster.

grades.requirement: For each of the three chosen cities, navigate to numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/[city-name] and record the cost of living index and the average price of a meal at an inexpensive restaurant shown on the page at task-start time. Note the date the Numbeo data was last updated for each city, since Brazilian cities are not always updated at the same frequency, and flag any city where the data appears older than 12 months.
grades.reasoning: The agent visited numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/ for São Paulo, Belo Horizonte, and presumably Rio de Janeiro (as it navigated to it in step 92), and obtained cost of living information for these cities. However, the requirement specifically asks to "note the date the Numbeo data was last updated for each city" and to "flag any city where the data appears older than 12 months." The agent failed to record or report the "last updated" dates found on the Numbeo pages for any of the three cities.

grades.requirement: On booking.com, search for hotels within 3 km of the stadium in each of the three cities for a single night during the tournament window. Record the cheapest available option with the property name, price per night, and the distance to the stadium as shown on the listing. For the same city, run a second search for a comparable night in the same month that falls outside the tournament window. Record the cheapest option and calculate the tournament-night price premium as a percentage over the non-tournament night, showing the calculation explicitly.
grades.reasoning: The agent attempted to gather hotel data on Booking.com for cities hosting the tournament. While the agent managed to construct a URL for a search, the subsequent history shows no evidence of successfully navigating, extracting, or recording the data required by the rubric (specifically, the cheapest hotel property name, price, and distance for tournament vs. non-tournament windows for three different cities, including the calculation of the percentage premium). The agent's activity stopped after attempting one search and did not produce the requested comparative analysis for any city.

grades.requirement:
Rank the three cities from most to least practical for the first-time South America visitor. Each ranking position must cite at least two specific figures from Phases 2 to 4, with no reasoning drawn from general Brazil travel knowledge or training recall about those cities.
For the top-ranked city, name one specific logistical risk that the data found during the task suggests could still go wrong for this visitor, tied to a figure rather than a general concern about travelling in Brazil.
grades.reasoning: The agent failed to complete the required steps for the ranking. While it visited FIFA, Rome2Rio, and Numbeo, it did not successfully perform the Booking.com search for the tournament window (the action 120 attempts to enter a long URL for a date in 2027, but the agent's action history ends immediately after without recording or comparing any hotel data for tournament vs. non-tournament nights). Furthermore, the agent never produced the required ranking of the three cities or the analysis of a specific logistical risk based on the data. The task was left unfinished.
